key_findings: P2X7 receptor KO reduced thermal and mechanical pain, GFAP/IBA1 gliosis, medial thalamic BDNF and 100 kDa P2X4 expression after VBC hemorrhage-induced CPSP.

CPSP lowered KCC2 and impaired GABAa-mediated chloride outflow in the thalamus; P2X7 KO restored chloride flux and muscimol-evoked multiunit activity without significantly changing KCC2, NKCC1, GABAa or TrkB expression.
